backend.envVarValue: bare host only, e.g. http://172.16.0.12 (no path) — same physical backend as CDM config/context/data/ontology
backend.gatewayPrefix: /api/decisionops-pod1/p0/cdm (via next.config.js rewrite, NOT backends.js — see routing note)
backend.routing: Does NOT go through _lib/proxy.js's createProxy/createCatchAllProxy or a BACKEND_PATHS entry. Routed by the next.config.js rewrite `{ source: '/api/log-management/:path*', destination: '${CDM_API}/logs/:path*' }` (next.config.js line ~64), where CDM_API = SERVICE_DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION_URL + '/api/decisionops-pod1/p0/cdm'. The backend's real upstream segment is still literally `/logs` (unchanged) — only our LOCAL /api/* convention was renamed 2026-07-20 from /api/logs to /api/log-management, to match the already-renamed service folder (src/services/log-management/) and admin page (/admin/log-management). A dynamic catch-all also exists at src/app/api/log-management/[...path]/route.js (makeCDMHandlers, backend DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION) as a fallback for when SERVICE_DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION_URL is unset and rewrites() returns []; per CLAUDE.md 'do not touch the CDM next.config.js rewrites', this specific line is the one deliberate, user-requested exception — every other CDM rewrite line was left untouched.
backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object }
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> — injected globally by src/proxy.js + src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js, never per-route.

plantField.name: plant_code_id
plantField.note: Query param on all 5 endpoints (all GET) per CLAUDE.md Rule 0. Never a custom X-PlantCodeId header. Renamed from the pre-refactor `plant_code` used on getActivity/getLogsSummary, and newly added to getLogsList/getLogs/getLogEvents which previously sent no plant field at all.

notes: LOG_MANAGEMENT is also a defined logical backend key in backends.js (SERVICE_LOG_MANAGEMENT_URL) but is dead/unused — no route resolves it. The real logs domain lives on DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION via the CDM rewrite, confirmed by literal URL match against the pasted table.

serviceFiles: src/services/log-management/logsService.js (consolidated 2026-07-14 — previously split between this thin wrapper and src/services/cdm/logsService.js, which is now deleted; cdm/index.js barrel no longer re-exports logs)
proxyRoutes: src/app/api/log-management/[...path]/route.js (fallback only, unreachable while the rewrite is active)

components: src/components/admin/views/LogsManagement.jsx (getActivity, getLogEvents, getLogsSummary — plant_code_id threaded from useApp().plantCode, 2026-07-14)

endpoints.name: getLogsList
endpoints.description: List all pipeline log files that can be served, with size and existence flag.
endpoints.notes: Zero UI consumers as of 2026-07-14 (user decision: API-layer-only wiring, no new UI in this pass — service function updated to the new contract and exported, not wired into PipelineLogsViewer's static PIPELINE_LOG_LABELS selector).

endpoints.name: getLogEvents
endpoints.serviceFunction: logsService.getLogEvents({ plantCodeId, source, level, q, limit })
endpoints.description: Parsed, filterable log events. Supports source (comma-joined), level, q, limit.
endpoints.notes: Previously sent NO plant field at all. LogsManagement.jsx's LogsTab already consumes events/facets by the same field names post-unwrap; total/histogram/sources are available but not yet surfaced in UI.

endpoints.name: getActivity
endpoints.description: Unified activity feed from audit tables, pipeline jobs and events.
endpoints.notes: Field renamed from plant_code to plant_code_id (was already being sent under the old name, just wrong key).

endpoints.name: getLogsSummary
endpoints.notes: Field renamed from plant_code to plant_code_id.

endpoints.name: getLogs
endpoints.description: Return the last N lines of a specific log file.
endpoints.notes: Previously sent NO plant field at all. `showing` is a new response field, not yet consumed by any UI (PipelineLogsViewer only reads lines/total_lines).
